Based on the provided images, here is the QA report:

**(1) LOBBY image:**
Yes, there is a humanoid soldier character visible on the right side of the screen. It looks like a **simple blocky low-poly figure** (specifically a dark silhouette/shape) rather than a detailed model with gear or uniforms.

**(2) BOT image:**
The soldier character is a **solid black silhouette**; it is **not** a realistic textured 3D soldier model. Yes, the character is **holding a rifle** (or similar long weapon) in a firing stance.

**(3) CITY image:**
The buildings show **flat colors** (dark blocks with simple glowing window lines), not photographic wall textures. The trees are **realistic 3D models** (leafy green clusters), not cones. 
**Visual Defects:** The graphics are extremely low-poly and basic. The "city" consists of untextured dark blocks, and the overall visual fidelity is very low compared to standard 3D FPS battle royale games.
